This is a bit of a dessert that not everyone thinks of when naming what they want after dinner. But it is good, it is no peach crisp, but what in the world can really compete with a good peach crisp? That's right. Nothing.

Base

7 cups sweet potatoes
1 cup sugar
3/4 cup butter
2 eggs
1/3 cup milk
1 teaspoon vanilla

Top

3/4 cup butter, melted
1 cup light brown sugar
1/2 cup flour
1 cup pecans, chopped

Before jumping in - you can use almonds and be just as happy with it if you don't like pecans.

Boil an amazingly large amount of sweet potatoes. Drain them, then using a potato masher, mash 'em.

Beat eggs, blend in butter. Add sugar after egg/butter mixture is reasonably consistent.

Pour the egg/sugar/butter mix into the sweet potato mash and blend well.

The mix will be a little stiff, add your bit of milk and vanilla.

Put the mix into a casserole dish with at least a quarter inch of space between the top of the mix and the top of the dish.

Mix topping in a bowl.

Sprinkle on the topping and bake at 350 degrees until top crisps and hardens. Probably less that fifteen minutes, I would keep an eye on it starting at 10.
